# meca-plata-pozo (ORM, docs/MECANISMOS_ADULTO.md, family F2, Pozo de Kakariko (de nino)), A: both CHILD at the entrance; the silver rupees of room 09 got (all five: the room's record), the silver token's two played events (it appears, it unlocks); B entering later.
# Run with --transport ws; switches below (#! switches). Needs daurosk branch orm/meca-adulto (the `key` test
# command) on orm/test8 (the `warp ... adult|child`, LICHII_COOP_DUNGEON_LISTS). Generated by
# tools/harness/meca_adulto.py: change the table there, not this file. Positions from the Banc, not walked yet:
# a 'test place ...: failed' or a 'goto timed out' is the scenario's gap, not the code's.
# Mutant: the same run without LICHII_COOP_DUNGEON_LISTS turns the 'never' lines of the adult list red.
#! noload
#! start coop: test warp done
#! saves 16-pozo
#! switches LICHII_COOP_PUPPET=1,LICHII_COOP_DEBUG_FLAGS=1,LICHII_COOP_DUNGEON_LISTS=shared_dungeon_adult.txt
#! timeout 231
#! expect B coop: puppet: P\d: create CoopPuppet_Child
#! expect A coop: test flag BottomOfTheWell_Level_Room_09_A_SilverRupee_GetAll \(0x74b2b996\) = 1: queued within plata..end
#! expect B coop: flags debug: bool 0x74b2b996 \(entry \d+\) 0 -> 1 within plata..end
#! expect A coop: test flag HavePlayedEvent\.BottomOfTheWell_SilverToken_Appear \(0x2bc2f7e6\) = 1: queued within aparece..end
#! expect B coop: flags debug: bool 0x2bc2f7e6 \(entry \d+\) 0 -> 1 within aparece..end
#! expect A coop: test flag HavePlayedEvent\.BottomOfTheWell_SilverToken_Unlock \(0x2e7e1465\) = 1: queued within abre..end
#! expect B coop: flags debug: bool 0x2e7e1465 \(entry \d+\) 0 -> 1 within abre..end
mark start
warp BottomOfTheWell Well_KakarikoSide child
wait 1200               # the title screen
mark title
press A
wait 180
press A
wait 180
press A
wait 300
press A                 # loads the save, then the warp
wait 2400               # the save loads, then the warp lands (about 30 s)
mark after
wait 600                # the other game lands too: puppets made
mark plata
flag BottomOfTheWell_Level_Room_09_A_SilverRupee_GetAll 1
wait 300
mark aparece
flag HavePlayedEvent.BottomOfTheWell_SilverToken_Appear 1
wait 300
mark abre
flag HavePlayedEvent.BottomOfTheWell_SilverToken_Unlock 1
wait 300
mark tarde
wait 600
wait 300
mark end
